admission.justification: Shared tmux or unreaped provider resources let concurrent tests terminate each other or leak children after cancellation.

applicability: Test-created tmux servers in the repository pytest population; the removed local Eve provider process/socket startup and collision-retry plane is outside current scope.
conditions: Each pytest process uses a private tmux socket directory.
exclusions: The user default tmux server is never owned by these tests.
No retry of unrelated startup failures.
Native SDK absence stays a reported skip.

evidence: two overlapping terminal runs3passed each; default server unchanged throughout; fake bind-collision proof; native Eve dependency cases skipped

statement: Every pytest process owns its test-created tmux server, using its private socket directory without touching the user default server.
